question1: How many years of ownership for Lao people?
answer1: Laotian citizens who purchase the condo have ownership and permanent use rights of the condo.
question2: How many years of ownership are there for foreigners?
answer2: Non Laotian customers who purchase this condo shall have ownership of the condo and a 50 year land use right. Upon expiration of the 50 year land use right,  each extension can be made for 30 years.
answer3: When buying our condo, you can choose to pay the full amount at once, which is simple and can enjoy large discounts and benefits; Also you can also the flexible installment payments, which can still enjoy certain discounts depending on the installment period. All in all, You can choose the most suitable payment method according to your needs and learn about our specific preferential policies in advance.
question4: What discounts are available for paying?
answer4: 5% discount: pay the full amount at once can enjoy a 5% discount on the price. The rental rebate policy support: Homeowners who pay the full amount in one lump sum can enjoy a continuous 5-year rental rebate policy support of 8% per year. After the rental rebate policy expires, it can be extended for 5 years.Free travel service:Enjoy 365 times free travel service with the city of Vientiane, which is providing convenient transportation support for  homeowner to enhance the living experience.
question5: What discounts are available for paying in installments?
answer5: 1-year installment payment owners can enjoy a continuous rental rebate policy of 7% per year for three years after paying the full purchase price. The rental rebate policy can be extended for seven years after expiration, and 1-Year installment payment no need to pay interest. 2-year installment payment owners can enjoy a continuous 3-year rental rebate policy support of 6% per year after paying the full purchase price. The rental rebate policy can be extended for 6 years after expiration. 3-year installment payment owners can enjoy a continuous 2-year, 6% annual rental rebate policy support after paying the full purchase price. The rental rebate policy can be extended for 5 years after expiration.
question6: Is the balcony area in the Condo fully priced?
answer6: The balcony area in the Condo suite is only half of the price, so that the owner's investment is more cost-effective.
answer7: Chief Level Security—VG has 24-hour security personnel on duty, 24-hour CCTV monitoring, 24-hour drone monitoring, and 24-hour live ammunition military security on duty. At the same time, over 50% of the surrounding area of VG community is surrounded by a small moat, which can serve as a natural barrier to isolate from the outside world and increase the safety of the park.
answer8: Adequate Parking Spaces—Currently, a common problem in many condos in Vientiane is insufficient parking spaces or the house owners need to drive to a faraway place to park. However, VG condos are equipped with a standard of one parking space per condo. At the same time, homeowners with multiple cars can also purchase other backup parking spaces for them, and the parking space is sufficient.
answer9: Full self occupied customers who purchase a house, they can enjoy free home cleaning services for 3 months(twice a week).
question10: What discounts are available at Vientiane Garden?
answer10: Permanent private access to investment consulting services for major projects in Laos; Permanent private 30% off taxi travel service, home cleaning service and private bodyguard travel services.

origin_of_group.title: Origin of Group Company Name
origin_of_group.subtitle: As a well-known enterprise in Laos, Zion Group Co., Ltd. operates in multiple industries including real estate, security, agriculture, trade, high-tech product development and operation, and property services. The company has strong financial strength and political and commercial resources. While possessing strong capabilities, the company attaches great importance to building its own soft power, especially in the construction of its corporate culture. The following is the origin of our company's name 'Zion':
origin_of_group.z:
Z - The first obstacles that the company encounters in its development are various obstacles, such as product quality, talent, channels, market, cash flow, etc. The company's development cannot be smooth sailing. It is like the English letter Z, which twists and turns. Therefore, we chose Z as the first letter of the company. It warns us to be ready to face difficulties at all times, to have an indomitable spirit and the courage to face setbacks, and to move forward through twists and turns!

    Lambs kneel for milk, crows feed back, and snakes and sparrows repay animals still have a grateful heart, let alone humans? In the process of growing together with the company, we hope that employees can think of their roots and be grateful to people or organizations (customers, family, friends, companies, etc.) who have shown kindness to us in the past. And the Mekong River is the root of the Laotian people. As the mother river of the Laotian people, it has nurtured generations of Laotians. The Mekong River is winding like the Z letter, so we have incorporated the Mekong River into the Z letter.
The mountains cannot be separated from the soil, so they can be high; the sea cannot be separated from the water, so they can be deep. Although the Mekong River is not as broad as the sea, it still surges and is rich in meaning, encompassing everything, with capacity and grandeur. Therefore, the Mekong River is always reminding us to maintain a humble and inclusive attitude.
origin_of_group.i: I - The competition between countries, just like the competition between enterprises, is ultimately a high-tech competition. As a local enterprise in Laos, engaging in the high-tech industry and maintaining a place in this field has always been our dream. In the later stage of the company's planning, we will enter the industry related to artificial intelligence AI and develop and operate IT products, so we have chosen the letter 'I' to indicate our future development direction.
origin_of_group.o:
O - The development of a company requires a mindset of pursuing excellence and perfection in order to do things well and promote the company to reach the pinnacle of the industry. And the letter O is like the moon in the sky on a full moon night, but if the moon is full, it will be lost. Therefore, we use O to warn everyone not to be arrogant or complacent even when the company reaches its peak and reaches perfection. After all, the next step towards perfection may be a low valley and a vast abyss. It constantly reminds us to maintain profitability, be aware of risks and crises, and maintain a humble attitude at all times!

     At the same time, as a company born and raised in Laos, we want to incorporate Laos' iconic products into our company's naming. Therefore, we chose Laos' national flower - Champa Flower, which means all the beauty, honor, and blessings in the world. And connecting the edges of the flowers together is like a letter O, just enough to wrap the Champa flowers. And the letter O also represents the collective spirit of unity and struggle among all members of the company!
origin_of_group.n:
N - Zion Group is involved in the security business. What letter is better to express security? After thinking about it, the most representative human building that has protected humanity since ancient times is probably the Great Wall of China. Therefore, we have designed a staircase like the Great Wall for the letter N. It also implies that we want to protect all the beauty of our loved ones, friends, companies, countries, and the world.

     The Great Wall of China was first built during the Spring and Autumn period and the Warring States period. It has been over 2000 years since then, but it is still magnificent and spectacular. Therefore, we also want to take advantage of it.

Wishing the company the image of the Great Wall to survive like the Great Wall, and to have a long-lasting foundation!

So, all the letters above are connected together to form the word ZION.

     And Zion is in ancient Hebrew, and the Catholic Bible is called Zion, which generally refers to Jerusalem, meaning the place of God. And the place where God is located is definitely the most beautiful and dreamy place in the world! At the same time, Zion was also a gathering place for righteous people in ancient times, which coincides with the purpose of our real estate work - 'finding a dream home for just customers'. Zion Real Estate looks forward to meeting, exchanging, and growing together with everyone, witnessing the beauty of the world together!
